questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer:
Very Easy. 
Deakin is very good at providing information and easy-to-follow step-by-step guides on how to log in and how to do it. + there is a very great student center, where you always could get the help you needed.

questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Single, duo or shared appartments with 4 - 10 people.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer:
No meal plans
There is kitchens all the apartments but you have to by your own cuttlery, puts , pans and stuff. 
Sometimes there is a food pantry coming to give free food.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: It is a bit far from the city. it takes 1 hour by public transport. But you get a lot closer with the other exchabge students quite fast when you liv here.

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: the level is a bit lower. they do not expect a lot from you in classes.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: All my classes did not have an exam. i wrote assignments through out the semester. i thught the workload was a bit too much. so maybe try to be better at going thorugh how the different courses exams you, so you dont end up with 10 assignemnts like i did.
